verdict.rationale: Nitrokey hosts an interactive Swagger UI over the live NetHSM OpenAPI spec on its public demo instance, and docs.nitrokey.com deep-links operations into it, so an interactive API reference exists. Runnable use is limited: it covers NetHSM only, and no demo credentials are published, so executing calls against the demo is not documented as turnkey. missing for 10: documented runnable/try-it examples with published demo credentials, coverage beyond NetHSM, independent or hands-on corroboration of executing calls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The NetHSM demo instance vendor-hosts Swagger UI over the live spec, and docs.nitrokey.com deep-links individual operations into it as "API documentation"
A public demo instance (nethsmdemo.nitrokey.com) also answers the API live; no demo credentials are published in the docs.
Nitrokey's NetHSM exposes a REST API described by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document
